svg.title: RB-CGF network topology
svg.desc: RB-CGF: Home network · UniFi Cloud Gateway Fiber. 5 VLANs with clients (1 Default, 2 Main Network, 3 IoT Devices, 4 Servers, 20 Home Lab Servers); 2 more with none (5 Local Devices, 10 Guest Network). 12 UniFi devices, 7 networks, 38 clients.
